segments.sn12.23:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“jānato ahaṃ, bhikkhave, passato āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi, no ajānato no apassato.
segments.sn12.23:1.3: Kiñca, bhikkhave, jānato kiṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti?
segments.sn12.23:1.4: Iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo, iti vedanā … pe … iti saññā … iti saṅkhārā … iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamoti.
segments.sn12.23:1.9: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, jānato evaṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti”.
segments.sn12.23:2.1: “Yampissa taṃ, bhikkhave, khayasmiṃ khayeññāṇaṃ, tampi saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:2.4: Vimuttimpāhaṃ [vimuttimpahaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ.)], bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:2.7: Virāgampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:2.10: Nibbidampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:2.13: Yathābhūtañāṇadassanampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:2.16: Samādhimpāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:3.3: Sukhampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:3.6: Passaddhimpāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:3.9: Pītimpāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:3.12: Pāmojjampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:3.15: Saddhampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:4.3: Dukkhampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:4.6: Jātimpāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:4.9: Bhavampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:4.12: Upādānampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:4.15: Taṇhampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:5.2: ‘Vedanā’ tissa vacanīyaṃ … pe …‘phasso’ tissa vacanīyaṃ …‘saḷāyatanan’ tissa vacanīyaṃ …‘nāmarūpan’ tissa vacanīyaṃ …‘viññāṇan’ tissa vacanīyaṃ …‘saṅkhārā’ tissa vacanīyaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:5.8: Saṅkhārepāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanise vadāmi, no anupanise.
segments.sn12.23:6.1: “Iti kho, bhikkhave, avijjūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanūpaniso phasso, phassūpanisā vedanā, vedanūpanisā taṇhā, taṇhūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādānūpaniso bhavo, bhavūpanisā jāti, jātūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkhūpanisā saddhā, saddhūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojjūpanisā pīti, pītūpanisā passaddhi, passaddhūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukhūpaniso samādhi, samādhūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassanūpanisā nibbidā, nibbidūpaniso virāgo, virāgūpanisā vimutti, vimuttūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.
segments.sn12.23:7.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, uparipabbate thullaphusitake deve vassante taṃ udakaṃ yathāninnaṃ pavattamānaṃ pabbatakandarapadarasākhā paripūreti. Pabbatakandarapadarasākhāparipūrā kusobbhe [kussubbhe (sī. syā. kaṃ.), kusubbhe (pī.) ṇvādi 129 suttaṃ oloketabbaṃ] paripūrenti. Kusobbhā paripūrā mahāsobbhe paripūrenti. Mahāsobbhā paripūrā kunnadiyo paripūrenti. Kunnadiyo paripūrā mahānadiyo paripūrenti. Mahānadiyo paripūrā mahāsamuddaṃ paripūrenti.
segments.sn12.23:8.1: “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, avijjūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanūpaniso phasso, phassūpanisā vedanā, vedanūpanisā taṇhā, taṇhūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādānūpaniso bhavo, bhavūpanisā jāti, jātūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkhūpanisā saddhā, saddhūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojjūpanisā pīti, pītūpanisā passaddhi, passaddhūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukhūpaniso samādhi, samādhūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassanūpanisā nibbidā, nibbidūpaniso virāgo, virāgūpanisā vimutti, vimuttūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇan”ti.

lines: Evaṃ santepi “jānato”ti ñāṇalakkhaṇaṃ upādāya puggalaṃ niddisati.
Passanappabhāvañhi ñāṇaṃ, ñāṇasamaṅgīpuggalo cakkhumā viya cakkhunā rūpāni, ñāṇena vivaṭe dhamme passati.
Āsavānaṃ khayanti ettha āsavānaṃ pahānaṃ asamuppādo khīṇākāro natthibhāvoti ayampi āsavakkhayoti vuccati, bhaṅgopi maggaphalanibbānānipi.
“Āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttin”tiādīsu (ma. ni.1.438; vibha.831) hi khīṇākāro āsavakkhayoti vuccati.
“Yo āsavānaṃ khayo vayo bhedo paribhedo aniccatā antaradhānan”ti (vibha.354) ettha bhaṅgo.
Khayasmiṃ paṭhamaṃ ñāṇaṃ, tato aññā anantarā”ti.(itivu.62);
So hi āsave khepento vūpasamento uppajjati, tasmā āsavānaṃ khayoti vutto.
Tañhi āsavānaṃ khīṇante uppajjati, tasmā āsavānaṃ khayoti vuttaṃ.
“Āsavā tassa vaḍḍhanti, ārā so āsavakkhayā”ti;(Dha. pa.253)–
Tañhi āgamma āsavā khīyanti, tasmā āsavānaṃ khayoti vuttaṃ.
No ajānato no apassatoti yo pana na jānāti na passati, tassa no vadāmīti attho.
Etena ye ajānato apassatopi saṃsārādīhiyeva suddhiṃ vadanti, te paṭikkhittā honti.
Purimena padadvayena upāyo vutto, iminā anupāyaṃ paṭisedheti.
Idāni yaṃ jānato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, taṃ dassetukāmo kiñca, bhikkhave, jānatoti pucchaṃ ārabhi.
Dabbajātiko eva hi koci bhikkhu chattaṃ kātuṃ jānāti, koci cīvarādīnaṃ aññataraṃ, tassa īdisāni kammāni vattasīse ṭhatvā karontassa sā jānanā saggamaggaphalānaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ na hotīti na vattabbaṃ.
Yo pana sāsane pabbajitvā vejjakammādīni kātuṃ jānāti, tassevaṃ jānato āsavā vaḍḍhantiyeva.
Tasmā yaṃ jānato passato ca āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, tadeva dassento iti rūpantiādimāha.
Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, jānatoti evaṃ pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ udayabbayaṃ jānantassa.
Āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti āsavānaṃ khayante jātattā “āsavānaṃ khayo”ti laddhanāmaṃ arahattaṃ hoti.
Evaṃ arahattanikūṭena desanaṃ niṭṭhapetvā idāni khīṇāsavassa āgamanīyaṃ pubbabhāgapaṭipadaṃ dassetuṃ yampissa taṃ, bhikkhavetiādimāha.
Tattha khayasmiṃ khayeñāṇanti āsavakkhayasaṅkhāte arahattaphale paṭiladdhe sati paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ.
Tañhi arahattaphalasaṅkhāte khayasmiṃ paṭhamavāraṃ uppanne pacchā uppannattā khayeñāṇanti vuccati.
Evaṃ ito paresupi labbhamānavasena paccayabhāvo veditabbo.
So hi kilese virājento khepento uppanno, tasmā virāgoti vuccati.
Balavavipassanāti bhayatūpaṭṭhāne ñāṇaṃ ādīnavānupassane ñāṇaṃ muñcitukamyatāñāṇaṃ saṅkhārupekkhāñāṇanti catunnaṃ ñāṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
Taruṇavipassanāti saṅkhāraparicchede ñāṇaṃ kaṅkhāvitaraṇe ñāṇaṃ sammasane ñāṇaṃ maggāmagge ñāṇanti catunnaṃ ñāṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
Sā hi appanāpubbabhāgassa sukhassa paccayo hoti.
Bhavoti kammabhavo.(So hi savikārāya jātiyā paccayo hoti.) Etenupāyena sesapadānipi veditabbāni.
Pabbatakandarapadarasākhāti ettha kandaraṃ nāma ‘kan’ tiladdhanāmena udakena dārito udakabhinno pabbatapadeso, yo “nitambo” tipi “nadīkuñcho” tipi vuccati.
Padaraṃ nāma aṭṭhamāse deve avassante phalito bhūmippadeso.
Evameva kho, bhikkhave, avijjūpanisā saṅkhārātiādīsu avijjā pabbatoti daṭṭhabbā.
Abhisaṅkhārā meghoti, viññāṇādivaṭṭaṃ kandarādayoti, vimutti sāgaroti.
Jānato passatoti ettha dassanaṃ paññācakkhunāva dassanaṃ adhippetaṃ, na maṃsacakkhunāti āha “dvepi padāni ekatthānī”ti.
Evaṃ santepīti padadvayassa ekatthattepi ñāṇalakkhaṇañāṇappabhāvavisayasssa tathādassanabhāvāvirodhanāti attho.
Jānato passatoti ca jānanadassanamukhena puggalādhiṭṭhānā desanā pavattāti āha –

Jānatoti vā vatvā na jānanaṃ anussavākāraparivitakkamattavasena idhādhippetaṃ, atha kho rūpāni viya cakkhuviññāṇena rūpādīni tesañca samudayādike paccakkhe katvā dassananti vibhāvetuṃ “passato”ti vuttanti evaṃ vā ettha attho.
So pana tesaṃ anuppādanirodho sabbena sabbaṃ abhāvo evāti āha “asamuppādo khīṇākāro natthibhāvo”ti.
Āsavakkhayasaddassa khīṇākārādīsu āgataṭṭhānaṃ dassetuṃ “āsavānaṃ khayā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Khayasmiṃ paṭhamaṃ ñāṇaṃ “tato aññā anantarā”ti khayasaṅkhāte aggamagge tappariyāpannameva ñāṇaṃ paṭhamaṃ uppajjati, tadanantaraṃ pana aññā arahattanti.
Yadipi gāthāya “khayasmiṃ” icceva vuttaṃ, samucchedavasena pana “āsave khīṇe maggo khayo”ti vuccatīti āha “maggo āsavakkhayoti vutto”ti.
Samaṇoti samitapāpo adhippeto, so pana khīṇāsavo hotīti.
“Āsavānaṃ khayā”ti idha phalaṃ, pariyāyena pana āsavakkhayo maggo, tena pattabbato phalaṃ.

Jānato eva passato evāti evamettha niyamo icchito, na aññathā visesābhāvato aniṭṭhāpannovāti tassa niyamassa phalaṃ dassetuṃ “no ajānato no apassato”ti vuttanti āha “yo pana na jānāti, na passati, tassa no vadāmīti attho”ti.
Iminā khandhānaṃ pariññā āsavakkhayassa ekantikakāraṇanti dasseti.
“Bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti (dī. ni.1.168; ma. ni.2.228) ahetū appaccayā sattā visujjhantī”ti (dī. ni.1.168; ma. ni.2.101,227) evamādivādā.
Tesu keci abhijātisaṅkantimattena saṃsārasuddhiṃ paṭijānanti, aññe issarapajāpatikāraṇādivasena.
Tayidaṃ sabbaṃ saṃsārādīhīti ettheva saṅgahitanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Anupāyo hoti esa āsavānaṃ khayassa, yadidaṃ pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ apariññāti “jānato passato”ti imināva aniyamavacanena anupāyapaṭisedhopi atthato bodhito hotīti.
Tameva hi atthato bodhitabhāvaṃ vibhāvetuṃ evaṃ saṃvaṇṇanā katāti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Yathāha “na kho dabba dabbā evaṃ nibbeṭhentī”ti (pārā.384).
Yo hi parisuddhājīvo kātuṃ ajānantānaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ attano vā vassavātādipaṭibāhanatthaṃ chattādīni karoti, so vattasīse ṭhatvā karoti nāma.
Padaṭṭhānaṃ na hotīti na vattabbaṃ nāthakaraṇadhammabhāvena maggaphalādhigamassa upanissayabhāvato.
Vuttañhi “yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ uccāvacāni kiccakaraṇīyāni, tattha dakkho hotī”tiādi (dī. ni.3.345).
Evaṃ jānatoti evaṃ vejjakammādīnaṃ jānanahetu micchājīvapaccayā kāmāsavādayo āsavā vaḍḍhantiyeva, na pahīyanti.
“Evaṃ kho … pe … āsavānaṃ khayo hotī”ti imāya pāḷiyā arahattasseva gahaṇaṃ yuttaṃ phalaggahaṇena hetuno avuttasiddhattā.
Manasmiṃ vivaṭṭanissite pana anantarūpanissayāpi paccayā sambhavantīti “labbhamānavasena paccayabhāvo veditabbo”ti vuttaṃ.
Paṭisaṅkhānupassanāpi muccitukamyatāpakkhikā evāti adhippāyena “catunnaṃ ñāṇānaṃ adhivacanan”ti vuttaṃ.
“Yāva maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhi, tāva taruṇavipassanā”ti hi vacanato upakkilesavimuttaudayabbayañāṇato paraṃ balavavipassanā.
Rūpārūpadhammānaṃ visesabhūto sāmaññabhūto ca yo yo sabhāvo yathāsabhāvo, tassa jānanaṃ yathāsabhāvajānanaṃ.
Paccakkhakaraṇatthena ñātapariññā tīraṇapariññā ca gahitā hoti.
So hi pādakajjhānasamādhi taruṇavipassanāya paccayo hoti.
“Samāhito yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti passatī”ti (saṃ. ni.3.5.;4.99;5.1071) hi vuttaṃ.
“Sukhaṃpāhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmī”ti ettha adhippetasukhaṃ dassetuṃ “appanāpubbabhāgassa sukhassā”ti vuttaṃ.
“Passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedetī”ti (dī. ni.1.466;3.359; a. ni.1.3.96) vuttaappanāsukhassa passaddhiyā paccayatte vattabbameva natthi.
Tādisā hi vitakkavicārasukhasamādhīhi laddhappaccayā nīvaraṇaṃ vikkhambhantī taṃnimittaṃ darathaṃ pariḷāhaṃ paṭipassambheti.
Saddhāti ratanattayaguṇānaṃ kammaphalassa ca saddahanavasena pavatto adhimokkho, sā pana yasmā attano visaye punappunaṃ uppajjati, na ekavārameva, tasmā āha “aparāparaṃ uppajjanasaddhā”ti.
Yasmā saddahanto saddheyyavatthusmiṃ pamudito hoti, tasmā āha “sā hi dubbalapītiyā paccayo hotī”ti.
Dukkhadukkhādibhedassa sabbassapi dukkhassa vaṭṭadukkhantogadhattā tassa ca idhādhippetattā vuttaṃ “dukkhanti vaṭṭadukkhan”ti.
Yasmā dukkhappatto kammassa phalāni saddahati, ratanattaye ca pasādaṃ uppādeti, tasmā vuttaṃ “tañhi aparāparasaddhāya paccayo hotī”ti.
Yasmā “ācariyānaṃ santike dhammaṃ sutvā pavattidukkhan”ti cintayato “ekantato ayaṃ dhammo imassa dukkhassa samatikkamāya hotī”ti saddhā uppajjati.
Tenāha “dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhatī”tiādi (dī. ni.1.191).
Jātiyā pana asati tattha tattha bhave natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti āha “sā hi vaṭṭadukkhassa paccayo”ti.
Anulomañāṇaṃ saṅkhārupekkhāpakkhikattā nibbānaggahaṇena gahitaṃ, gotrabhuñāṇaṃ paṭhamamaggassa āvajjanaṃ.
So hi tena vipassanāya kiñci kiñci visesaṭṭhānaṃ kayiratīti taṃ anāmasitvā nibbidūpaniso virāgoti “virāgo” icceva vuttaṃ.
Yathā ninnaṃ udakaṃ pavattati, tathā nivattanabhāvena nadīkuñchotipi vuccati.
Hemantagimhautuvasena aṭṭha māse pavatto pathavīvivaroti katvā padaro.
Khuddikā udakavāhiniyo sākhā viyāti sākhā, khuddakā sobbhā kusubbhā o-kārassa u-kāraṃ katvā.
Evameva khotiādi “seyyathāpi, bhikkhave”tiādinā upanītāya upamāya upameyyena saṃsandananti, taṃ yojetvā dassetuṃ “avijjā pabbatoti daṭṭhabbā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Tattha avijjā ca santānavasena ciraṃtanakālappavattanato pacurajanehi duppajahanato “pabbato”ti vuttā.
Vimutti ekarasattā, hānivuddhiabhāvato ca sāgarasadisāti upamāsaṃsandanaṃ.
